note: Font data for the UI scale packs (J37, D7). `engine`: how Napoleon.exe turns a font name or size into a .cuf file (static RE, uiscale/runs/2026-11-03_j37_static). `engine_text`: the .cuf files the exe opens by itself for engine-drawn text, rendered at the install factor (kind render) or filled with a layout slot's render where the GetFont clamp redirects a list name (kind alias). J67 adds the `layouts` key (the per-factor slot rows for the scaled layouts and templates); this file does not hold them yet.

fixed_opens.frontend_22.cuf: GetFont("Frontend", 22) at 0xdae510 (text style, MVC Create UIs) and 0x1215a20 (ribbon.fx text)
fixed_opens.frontend_16.cuf: loading quote fit loop; dev console 0xe33450
fixed_opens.frontend_12.cuf: loading quote fit loop; dev console 0xe33450
fixed_opens.ingame_16.cuf: render statistics overlay 0x1197430 (also a list slot)

engine_text.why: the two fixed GetFont("Frontend", 22) callers; no scaled layout names Frontend 22 at 2x (the scaler maps it to Frontend 38 or 24)
loading-quote fit loop: the largest file whose text fits the box is kept
loading-quote fit loop (the dev console's 16 follows; dev only)
loading-quote fit loop (the dev console's 12 follows; dev only)
GetFont clamps 38 to 32: the list name Frontend 38 opens frontend_32.cuf, so the slot render built for Frontend 38 must sit in frontend_32.cuf

layouts_note: Slot fonts per factor (J67; J37 adds an 'engine_text' key beside 'layouts' and does not change these rows). 'layouts': the .cuf slot files the scaled layouts and templates name (scale.py font_slot picks the slot as at 2x at every factor) and the size each is rendered at: render_scale x the slot file's own vanilla size (em = vanilla h2 x 23/24 x render_scale, h2 = px(vanilla h2 x render_scale)), so text named 'Ingame 12' renders at 12 x factor. At 2.0 the scale is 1 and the pack is byte-identical to J66's (5f510b27afa3). bold: drawn at wght 700 fitted to the vanilla width (cuf_encode.recipe); spaced_h2: the long-form line pitch slot (frontend_24, h2 28 at 2x). Read by uiscale/napoleon/cli.py build_fonts; the check verb reports a layout font with no row.
